messages:
aj: Quick heads-up — initiating a soft freeze in ~18h for the next rollout. Target version: v1.8.x (see below). Please get any merge-ready fixes and changelog entries in before cutoff. Rolling window is Thu 09:00 PT; release bot will enable branch protection at cutoff. If you need an exception, call it out now.

maria: On it. I have one PR blocked by the docs linter, pinging @devon for the review. ETA ~3h to clear.

devon: can review now, but quick question — do we treat this as 1.8.0 (feature) or 1.8.1 (bugfix)? small tokenizer fix only.

aj: If it's strictly a bugfix, bump to 1.8.1. Reserve 1.8.0 for the feature bundle. Use `git tag -a v1.8.1 -m \"v1.8.1\"` and open the release PR against `release/1.8`.

maria: noted — updating PR description with changelog snippet.

release-bot: heads-up: branch protection and required reviews will be enforced at cutoff timestamp 1901240000 (Thu 09:00 PT). Any merges after that will need an exception.

sre-oncall: FYI we'll be throttling canary traffic during the rollout window. If latency or error rate crosses thresholds, alert #eng-sre and tag me.

maria: changelog entry (draft):

```
Fixes
- Tokenizer: prevent OOM for long prompts when KV cache grows (fixes race in cache resize). Reviewed by @devon.
```

product-lead: I'd like to pull one noncritical UI polish out of this ship — can we push it to the next cycle? Not urgent.

aj: ok — add the `hold` label to that PR and mention it here so release notes ignore it. Also reminder to run the preflight checks: `make release-checks` (lint, tests, changelog lint, bundle-size).

devon: patch pushed, docs linter fixed, ran `make release-checks` locally — all green. opened release PR and tagged `v1.8.1-rc1`.

aj: :thumbsup: I'll kick the canary at 09:15 PT and monitor for 30m. If all good, we'll promote to full rollout at 09:45 PT. I'll post the announcement in #announcements after canary looks solid.

maria: thanks — doing a final pass on release PR description and changelog formatting.

release-bot: Canary started by @aj at 1901240900. Monitor: https://releases.redwood/example/1.8.1-rc1

sre-oncall: saw a small latency blip during the first 2 minutes; it recovered. Keeping an eye on errors.

aj: canary green at +28m. Promoting to full rollout now. Posting announcement in #announcements in 5.

product-lead: thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc for the next window.

devon: merging backport for the token fix to `main`.

aj: release complete. Final version: v1.8.1. Release notes posted. If you hit any regressions, open an incident and ping me and @sre-oncall.
